plan: Solaris-web-Hydra: from prototype to product (four upgrades borrowed from Synapse)

environment.cloud: An AI coding agent in a cloud Linux container with Python, Node, usd-core and headless Chromium with software rendering. No Houdini, no GPU, no Windows, no access to Joe's files, accounts or email.
environment.desk: Joe's Windows workstation: Houdini 22 and hython, Karma, an RTX 4090, his real Solaris scenes and exports, his phone, his GitHub and email accounts. Available on weekday afternoons only.
environment.joe: A senior lighting TD and solo developer who owns every product, licensing, money and taste decision.

tasks.title: Put the prototype in a private GitHub repo
tasks.detail: Create JosephOIbrahim/solaris-web-hydra as a private repository under Joe's GitHub account and push the prototype from the zip into it.

tasks.title: First run on the 4090
tasks.detail: Run npm install and npm start on Joe's workstation, open the viewer in Chrome, and read the status line for revision, cross-origin isolation and fallback count.

tasks.title: Census one real export
tasks.detail: Export one real asset from a Solaris scene with the USD ROP using relative paths, then run web_census.py on it with hython.

tasks.title: Define 'looks right' for the first real scene
tasks.detail: Write down what counts as done when comparing the web render with the Karma render, so the first real scene has a finish line.

tasks.title: Pick reload-on-cook or live edits
tasks.detail: Choose whether the live viewport reloads the whole stage when the LOP network cooks, or pushes individual edits live.

tasks.title: Email Needle about commercial terms
tasks.detail: Write to hi@needle.tools in Joe's name to ask for commercial licence terms and whether @needle-tools/usd will move to MaterialX 1.8.0.

tasks.title: Add a lockfile and Playwright
tasks.detail: Generate package-lock.json and add Playwright as a dev dependency so tests run from a fresh install.

tasks.title: Shadows for every key light
tasks.detail: The lighting bridge in site/main.js only gives shadows to a light whose path ends in /key. Choose shadow casters from the lights' own attributes instead.

tasks.title: Read .exr dome textures
tasks.detail: The lighting bridge loads dome textures with HDRLoader only. Add EXRLoader for .exr domes and test it on a fixture.

tasks.title: Cache the WASM
tasks.detail: serve.mjs sends Cache-Control no-store, so each reload refetches the 35 MB WASM. Cache static vendor files and keep stage files fresh.

tasks.title: Learn the census allowlist from a real export
tasks.detail: Read the JSON from the census of Joe's real export and update the tested shader and texture lists in web_census.py.

tasks.title: Write the look-score script
tasks.detail: Use Retina's SSIM from the Synapse repo to compare each web screenshot with the last approved frame, driven by the existing Playwright test.

tasks.title: Set the SSIM floor on the 4090
tasks.detail: Render the same view twice on Joe's GPU and measure SSIM between the runs, to set a floor real hardware can pass.

tasks.title: Ping Synapse from a 10-line client
tasks.detail: Open Synapse's WebSocket from a small script on Joe's machine with Houdini running, send ping, then call the Solaris component builder.

tasks.title: Watch-and-reload in serve.mjs
tasks.detail: Add a file watcher and server-sent events to serve.mjs so the browser reloads the stage when a marker file changes.

tasks.title: Post-render hook on the USD ROP
tasks.detail: In Houdini, add a post-render script to the USD ROP that touches the marker file after each export, and confirm the browser reloads.
